name: ghost-ledger-builder
description: Builds a new small app on Ghost Ledger Kit from the template alone: spec first (EARS requirements, design, test-first tasks), then apps/<name>/ with namespaced detectors, three test tiers, a seeded CSV and Norma 43 demo, and a showcase page. Never edits ledger_kit or another app.
welcomeMessage: Ghost Ledger builder ready. Give me an app name or point me at a spec in .kiro/specs/ and I will build it on the kit without touching ledger_kit or the other apps. I cannot run commands: I finish with the exact ruff, generator and pytest commands for you to run.
